data_kind: chosen probability/partner-selection model, not GRIFFIN events or geometry
coarse_bin: H(X,Y)=1 if X equals Y; two binary photon direction/response tags, no actual angular kernel
prompt: average H(X_i,Y_i) from the same physical event
mixed: for each X_i select K distinct Y_j uniformly without replacement among j != i; choices independent between trigger rows
boundaries: conditioned on fixed N and full two-tag detection for every event
no time drift/background/DAQ/gate/efficiency or physical Legendre kernel
ratio delta approximation requires positive non-small denominator; small-N zero denominators are explicitly counted
not a recalculation of GRIFFIN experimental covariance
